# Brookings
> Independent nonprofit public policy research institution publishing analysis, events, expert commentary, and books on major domestic and global issues.

The Brookings Institution is a Washington, DC–based think tank focused on in-depth research that informs policy solutions at the local, national, and global level. Its website organizes content across research programs, expert profiles, topic hubs, regional analysis, public events, media resources, institutional information, and Brookings Institution Press publications.

## Research & Commentary
- [Research & Commentary](https://www.brookings.edu/research-commentary/): Main hub for Brookings articles, reports, explainers, and policy analysis.
- [Topics](https://www.brookings.edu/topics/): Browse Brookings research by policy topic and issue area.
- [Immigration](https://www.brookings.edu/topics/immigration-5/): Research and commentary on immigration policy, integration, and labor market effects.
- [Housing](https://www.brookings.edu/topics/housing/): Analysis of housing affordability, supply, urban development, and related policy.
- [Tariffs](https://www.brookings.edu/tags/tariffs/): Tagged commentary and analysis related to tariffs and trade policy.
- [USMCA Forward 2026](https://www.brookings.edu/collection/usmca-forward-2026/): Collection examining North American trade and the future of USMCA.
- [Iran](https://www.brookings.edu/regions/middle-east-north-africa/iran/): Regional analysis and commentary focused on Iran and related policy issues.

## Experts
- [Experts](https://www.brookings.edu/experts/): Directory of Brookings scholars, fellows, and affiliated policy experts.
- [For Media](https://www.brookings.edu/for-media/): Media contact information, interview resources, and journalist support.
- [Leadership](https://www.brookings.edu/about-us/leadership/): Profiles of Brookings senior leadership and institutional officers.

## Events & Public Programs
- [Events](https://www.brookings.edu/events/): Calendar of public events, panels, webinars, and policy discussions.
- [Newsletters](https://www.brookings.edu/newsletters/): Subscription hub for Brookings newsletters and research updates.

## Research Programs
- [Research Programs](https://www.brookings.edu/research-programs/): Overview of Brookings research centers, programs, and institutional priorities.

## Regions, Topics & Collections
- [Topics](https://www.brookings.edu/topics/): Central index of issue-based research categories across Brookings.
- [Iran](https://www.brookings.edu/regions/middle-east-north-africa/iran/): Country-focused research page within Brookings regional coverage.
- [USMCA Forward 2026](https://www.brookings.edu/collection/usmca-forward-2026/): Thematic collection on trade, competitiveness, and North American cooperation.
- [Immigration](https://www.brookings.edu/topics/immigration-5/): Topic page aggregating immigration-related publications and commentary.
- [Housing](https://www.brookings.edu/topics/housing/): Topic page aggregating housing policy research and analysis.
- [Tariffs](https://www.brookings.edu/tags/tariffs/): Tag archive for tariff-related posts, commentary, and analysis.

## Books & Publishing
- [Brookings Institution Press](https://www.brookings.edu/all-books/brookings-institution-press/): Catalog of books and publications from Brookings Institution Press.

## About Brookings
- [About Us](https://www.brookings.edu/about-us/): Institutional overview, mission, history, and organizational information.
- [Leadership](https://www.brookings.edu/about-us/leadership/): Leadership team, governance, and executive profiles.
- [Our Commitments](https://www.brookings.edu/about-us/#commitments): Institutional commitments and principles highlighted on the about page.
- [Our Finances](https://www.brookings.edu/about-us/finances/): Financial information and transparency resources for the institution.
- [Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion](https://www.brookings.edu/dei-report-2025/): Brookings DEI report and related institutional commitments.

## Careers & Support
- [Careers](https://www.brookings.edu/careers/): Employment opportunities and hiring information at Brookings.
- [Support Brookings](https://www.brookings.edu/support-brookings/): Donation and giving page supporting Brookings research and programs.

## Media & Outreach
- [For Media](https://www.brookings.edu/for-media/): Press resources, media inquiries, and expert booking information.
- [Newsletters](https://www.brookings.edu/newsletters/): Email subscriptions for policy analysis, events, and institutional updates.
- [Events](https://www.brookings.edu/events/): Public programming and event listings for Brookings audiences.
